title: Zavelyn Handpan™ Master (12-Tone 432Hz D-Minor Kurd)
body_html:
The Definitive 22-Inch Concert Handpan in Pure 432 Hz Resonance

The Zavelyn Handpan™ Master represents the absolute zenith of harmonic sound sculpture. Meticulously hand-hammered and nitrogen-hardened from high-grade nitrided carbon steel, this full-sized 22-inch (55 cm) concert instrument is tuned in D-Minor Kurd across 12 resonant tone fields at the biological healing frequency of 432 Hz.

Why the Zavelyn Handpan™ Master is Unrivaled:

  • 12 Harmonic Tone Fields (D-Minor Kurd): Central Ding (D3) surrounded by 11 meticulously tuned dimples (A3, Bb3, C4, D4, E4, F4, G4, A4, C5, D5, E5) providing expansive melodic storytelling.
  • Concert-Grade Cathedral Sustain: Nitrided steel treatment creates warm, bell-like sustain that lingers in the air without dissonant cross-talk.
  • 432 Hz Natural Biological Alignment: Calibrated to induce deep parasympathetic relaxation, heart-rate deceleration, and restorative meditative states.
  • Hand-Hammered Artistry: Every individual tone field is shaped and tuned by master acoustic artisans with lifelong pitch stability.
  • All-Weather Protection: High-temperature nitriding provides extreme scratch, moisture, and corrosion resistance.

What's Included in Your Complete Master Set:

  • 1x Zavelyn Handpan™ Master (22-Inch / 55 cm, 12 Notes, 432 Hz)
  • 1x Foldable Heavy-Duty Aluminum Handpan Tripod Stand
  • 1x Premium Padded Travel Backpack with Reinforced Dual Shoulder Straps
  • 1x Pair of Acoustic Wooden Mallets with Balanced Rubber Heads
  • 1x Hand-Woven Protective Braided Edge Rope Wrap
  • 1x Set of Visual Tone Stickers
  • 1x Microfiber Instrument Cleaning Cloth
